editorial:
Imagine being a world-class killer before you even get your driver's license. That is exactly where you find Agent 864, a teen girl who is tired of the spy life and just wants to go to prom. She fakes her own death to sneak into a regular American high school, thinking that fitting in will be a breeze. You will love the funny contrast between her deadly skills and her total lack of social skills. The vibe is lighthearted and breezy, making it a great pick for a lazy Friday night when you just want to turn your brain off and enjoy some chaos.

Hailee Steinfeld does a great job playing the awkward yet dangerous lead, and the action scenes are snappy and fun. While the plot is pretty predictable, the chemistry between the characters keeps you invested. If you are looking for a light action flick, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up when the secret spy agency finds the main character and tries to force her back. She uses her training to fight off the bad guys during a school event, proving she can be both a warrior and a student. She eventually makes peace with her past and decides to stay in school to live a normal life. She earns the respect of her classmates and finally gets the teenage experience she always wanted.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen comedies with a twist of action.
